name: SDN Record Retention Flow
description: Hourly rolling-window retention (typed contracts 1.0): the host-cron timer's TimerTick enters data-source/record-retention expire, which asks the node (storage.expire, an SDS $PIV hostcall) to delete each configured lane's records that arrived on the node more than window_hours ago (node config; default 72 h over WXF from provider noaa-ncep), through the store's record index. Owner 2026-10-12, the weather node: a rolling 3-day window, configurable, never an archive. Each lane pass's FlowNotice (FNTC: Expired / Missing / Skipped) ends at the flow egress. No JSON.

triggers.description: Retention pass timer, hourly: the window's edge moves an hour a pass.
